g.text: Annual education spending among students in rural Punjab
Most students spend far less on education than the highest spenders
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household data. Sample: students in rural Punjab with ed_total > 0 (n = 9,173).
Weighted by household weight (hhweight). 3 students outside Rs 100 to Rs 1,000,000 are excluded.
